title: WaterSound 90 Watch Tower Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- New construction- Private heated pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for an additional $45 per day**- 6 adult bikes- Gas grill- Elevator- Private access to boardwalk- Outdoor entertainment area- 2 laundry rooms- 2 primary suites - From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters laundered upon every checkout. This property comes with 2 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: This gorgeous 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom WaterSound home is steps from a private beach and comfortably sleeps 12. It features a private heated pool, multiple balconies with Gulf views, a whole-home air purification system, and direct, private access to the boardwalk through WaterSound. On the first floor, guests will find a gourmet chef's kitchen equipped with premium, stainless-steel appliances. With casual seating for 5 at the bar and 8 at the dining table, guests have plenty of space to gather and enjoy a meal together. Gather in comfort knowing a UV whole-home air purification system is actively removing viruses, bacteria, mold, and odors from the air! Outside is a gas grill, flat-screen TV, and sunning deck. A bedroom down the hall contains a queen bed and a private bathroom. On the second floor are 3 guest bedrooms and a primary bedroom. The primary bedroom has a king bed, a private balcony facing the Gulf, a double-vanity bathroom, and a soaking tub. Two additional guest bedrooms have king beds and private bathrooms with showers. A fourth bedroom has a queen bed and a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo.The third floor has a bonus living room to entertain the kids. A bedroom with 2 double beds in the only guest room with a hall bathroom. There is also an observation lookout tower on the top level with stunning Gulf views. Guests can indeed find it all here! With bountiful amenities and a generous, multi-level floor plan—it’s like staying in your own castle, only steps from a private beach. Staying in WaterSound also grants exclusive access to private nature trails and neighborhood pools. Explore on 6 included adult bikes! Don’t miss your chance to book this stunning home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*The garage is not for guest use.
